_comment: Setting NAMES a KreweWorks Static Web App needs. provision.sh fills them from the private client profile. Values live only in the SWA configuration. Never commit values.
AZURE_CLIENT_ID: <sign-in app registration id (multi-tenant, consented in the client tenant)>
AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET: <its client secret, from AWS Secrets Manager>
PORTAL_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID: <app id used for Graph directory reads and Mail.Send>
PORTAL_STORAGE_CONNECTION: <connection string of this client's own storage account>
PORTAL_MAIL_ENABLED: false until the pilot is approved
KREWEWORKS_PROFILE_PATH: <optional: absolute path to the profile; normally the deploy writes api/src/profiles/active.json>
PORTAL_PII_KEY: <32 random bytes, base64; encrypts SSN, date of birth and license numbers in the online packet. Created once by provision.sh; never rotate without re-encrypting.>
